library(Seurat)
library(dplyr)
library(Matrix)
library(ggplot2)
library(tidyr)
library(RColorBrewer)
library(ArchR)
addArchRGenome("hg38")
pathFragments="/data/scell/ATAC/"
inputFiles <- list.files(pathFragments, pattern = ".fragments.tsv.gz", full.names = TRUE)
names(inputFiles) <- gsub(".fragments.tsv.gz", "", list.files(pathFragments, pattern = ".fragments.tsv.gz"))
inputFiles <- inputFiles[!grepl(".tbi", inputFiles)]
ArrowFiles <- createArrowFiles(
  inputFiles = inputFiles,
  sampleNames = names(inputFiles),
  filterTSS = 6, 
  filterFrags = 2000, 
  addTileMat = TRUE,
  addGeneScoreMat = TRUE
)

proj1 <- ArchRProject(
  ArrowFiles = ArrowFiles, 
  outputDirectory = "out1",
  copyArrows = FALSE
)

proj1 <- addDoubletScores(proj1)
proj1 <- filterDoublets(proj1)

proj1
#getAvailableMatrices(proj1)
df <- getCellColData(proj1, select = c("log10(nFrags)", "TSSEnrichment"))

p <- ggPoint(
    x = df[,1], 
    y = df[,2], 
    colorDensity = TRUE,
    continuousSet = "sambaNight",
    xlabel = "Log10 Unique Fragments",
    ylabel = "TSS Enrichment",
    xlim = c(log10(500), quantile(df[,1], probs = 0.99)),
    ylim = c(0, quantile(df[,2], probs = 0.99))
) + geom_hline(yintercept = 4, lty = "dashed") + geom_vline(xintercept = 3, lty = "dashed")

plotPDF(p, name = "TSS-vs-Frags.pdf", ArchRProj = proj1, addDOC = FALSE)

p1 <- plotGroups(
    ArchRProj = proj1, 
    groupBy = "Sample", 
    colorBy = "cellColData", 
    name = "TSSEnrichment",
    plotAs = "ridges"
   )

p2 <- plotGroups(
    ArchRProj = proj1, 
    groupBy = "Sample", 
    colorBy = "cellColData", 
    name = "TSSEnrichment",
    plotAs = "violin",
    alpha = 0.4,
    addBoxPlot = TRUE
   )
p3 <- plotGroups(
    ArchRProj = proj1, 
    groupBy = "Sample", 
    colorBy = "cellColData", 
    name = "log10(nFrags)",
    plotAs = "ridges"
   )

p4 <- plotGroups(
    ArchRProj = proj1, 
    groupBy = "Sample", 
    colorBy = "cellColData", 
    name = "log10(nFrags)",
    plotAs = "violin",
    alpha = 0.4,
    addBoxPlot = TRUE
   )

plotPDF(p1,p2,p3,p4, name = "QC-Sample-Statistics.pdf", ArchRProj = proj1, addDOC = FALSE, width = 4, height = 4)

p1 <- plotFragmentSizes(ArchRProj = proj1)
p2 <- plotTSSEnrichment(ArchRProj = proj1)
plotPDF(p1,p2, name = "QC-Sample-FragSizes-TSSProfile.pdf", ArchRProj = proj1, addDOC = FALSE, width = 5, height = 5)

proj1 <- addGeneScoreMatrix(proj1,matrixName = "GeneScoreMatrix",force = T)
proj1 <- addIterativeLSI(
    ArchRProj = proj1,
    useMatrix = "TileMatrix", 
    name = "IterativeLSI", 
    iterations = 2, 
    clusterParams = list( #See Seurat::FindClusters
       resolution = c(0.2), 
        sampleCells = 10000, 
        n.start = 10
    ), 
    varFeatures = 25000, 
    dimsToUse = 1:30
)



proj2 <- addClusters(
    input = proj1,
    reducedDims = "IterativeLSI",
    method = "Seurat",
    name = "Clusters",
    resolution = 2
)

proj2 <- addUMAP(
    ArchRProj = proj2, 
    reducedDims = "IterativeLSI", 
    name = "UMAP", 
    nNeighbors = 30, 
    minDist = 0.5, 
    metric = "cosine"
)




p1 <- plotEmbedding(ArchRProj = proj2, colorBy = "cellColData", name = "Sample", embedding = "UMAP")
p2 <- plotEmbedding(ArchRProj = proj2, colorBy = "cellColData", name = "Clusters", embedding = "UMAP")
plotPDF(p1,p2, name = "Plot-UMAP-Sample-Clusters.pdf", ArchRProj = proj2, addDOC = FALSE, width = 5, height = 5)


sc=readRDS("sc.celltype.rds")
sc_meta=sc@meta.data
sc_meta$ID=paste0(sc_meta$sample,sc_meta$batch)

groupList <- SimpleList()
for (id in levels(factor(proj2$ID))){
  rna.sub <- sc_meta[sc_meta$ID == id,]
  RNA.cells <- rownames(rna.sub)

  idxSample <- BiocGenerics::which(proj2$ID == id)
  ATAC.cells <- proj2$cellNames[idxSample] 
                                          
  groupList[[id]] <- SimpleList(          
    ATAC = unique(ATAC.cells),
    RNA = unique(RNA.cells)
  )                
} 

proj3 <- addGeneIntegrationMatrix(
    ArchRProj = proj2,     
    useMatrix = "GeneScoreMatrix",
    matrixName = "GeneIntegrationMatrix",
    reducedDims = "IterativeLSI",
    seRNA = sc,
   # groupList = groupList,
    addToArrow = FALSE,
    groupRNA = "celltype",
    nameCell = "predictedCell_Un",
    nameGroup = "predictedGroup_Un",
    nameScore = "predictedScore_Un",
    force = TRUE
)

proj3 <- addGeneIntegrationMatrix(
    ArchRProj = proj3,     
    useMatrix = "GeneScoreMatrix",
    matrixName = "GeneIntegrationMatrix",
    reducedDims = "IterativeLSI",
    seRNA = sc,
    groupList = groupList,
    addToArrow = TRUE,
    groupRNA = "celltype",
    nameCell = "predictedCell_Co",
    nameGroup = "predictedGroup_Co",
    nameScore = "predictedScore_Co",
    force = TRUE
)

saveArchRProject(ArchRProj = proj3, outputDirectory = "out3", load = FALSE)
pal <- paletteDiscrete(values = unique(proj3$predictedGroup_Co))
p1 <- plotEmbedding(
    proj3, 
    colorBy = "cellColData", 
    name = "predictedGroup_Un", 
    pal = pal
)
p2 <- plotEmbedding(
    proj3, 
    colorBy = "cellColData", 
    name = "predictedGroup_Co", 
    pal = pal
)
plotPDF(p1,p2, name = "Plot-UMAP-RNA-Integration.pdf", ArchRProj = proj3, addDOC = FALSE, width = 5, height = 5)
proj3<- addHarmony(
    ArchRProj = proj3,
    reducedDims = "IterativeLSI",
    name = "Harmony",
    groupBy = "Sample"
)
proj3<- addUMAP(
    ArchRProj = proj3, 
    reducedDims = "Harmony", 
    name = "UMAPHarmony", 
    nNeighbors = 30, 
    minDist = 0.5, 
    metric = "cosine"
)

p1 <- plotEmbedding(ArchRProj = proj3, colorBy = "cellColData", name = "sample", embedding = "UMAP")+ guides(color = guide_legend(override.aes = list(size = 5)))
p2 <- plotEmbedding(ArchRProj = proj3, colorBy = "cellColData", name = "batch", embedding = "UMAP")

p3 <- plotEmbedding(ArchRProj = proj3, colorBy = "cellColData", name = "sample", embedding = "UMAPHarmony")
p4 <- plotEmbedding(ArchRProj = proj3, colorBy = "cellColData", name = "batch", embedding = "UMAPHarmony")

plotPDF(p1,p2,p3,p4, name = "Plot-UMAP2Harmony-Sample-Clusters.pdf", ArchRProj =proj3, addDOC = FALSE, width = 5, height = 5)

proj 3<- addGroupCoverages(ArchRProj = proj3,groupBy = "celltype",force = T)
proj3 <- addReproduciblePeakSet(
  ArchRProj = proj3,
  groupBy = "celltype",
  pathToMacs2 = "/path/bin/macs2",force = T
)
proj 3<- addPeakMatrix(proj3,force = T)
proj 3<- addBgdPeaks(proj3)
proj3 <- addDeviationsMatrix(
  ArchRProj = proj3, 
  peakAnnotation = "Motif",
  force = TRUE
)



markersPeaks <- getMarkerFeatures(
  ArchRProj = proj3,
  useMatrix = "PeakMatrix",
  groupBy = "celltype",
  bias = c("TSSEnrichment", "log10(nFrags)"),
  testMethod = "wilcoxon"
)
heatmapPeaks<- markerHeatmap(
  seMarker = markersPeaks,
  cutOff = "FDR <= 0.01 & Log2FC >= 1",
  labelMarkers =NULL,
  transpose = F,
  pal =  viridis(n=256),
  limits = c(-2,2)
)

plotPDF(heatmapPeaks, name = "Markers_peaks_ATAC_clusters.pdf", width = 8, height = 6, ArchRProj = proj3, addDOC = FALSE)


markerTest <- getMarkerFeatures(
  ArchRProj = proj3,
  useMatrix = "PeakMatrix",
  groupBy = "celltype",
  bias = c("TSSEnrichment", "log10(nFrags)"),
  testMethod = "wilcoxon",
  useGroups = "Malignant", bgdGroups = "OPC"
) 

proj3<- addMotifAnnotations(ArchRProj = proj3, motifSet = "cisbp", name = "Motif")
motifsUp <- peakAnnoEnrichment(
    seMarker = markerTest,
    ArchRProj = proj,
    peakAnnotation = "Motif",
    cutOff = "FDR <= 0.1 & Log2FC >= 1"
  )
df <- data.frame(TF = rownames(motifsUp), mlog10Padj = assay(motifsUp)[,1])
df <- df[order(df$mlog10Padj, decreasing = TRUE),]
df$rank <- seq_len(nrow(df))

ggUp <- ggplot(df, aes(rank, mlog10Padj, color = mlog10Padj)) + 
  geom_point(size = 1) +
  ggrepel::geom_label_repel(
        data = df[rev(seq_len(30)), ], aes(x = rank, y = mlog10Padj, label = TF), 
        size = 1.5,
        nudge_x = 2,
        color = "black"
  ) + theme_ArchR() + 
  ylab("-log10(P-adj) Motif Enrichment") + 
  xlab("Rank Sorted TFs Enriched") +
  scale_color_gradientn(colors = paletteContinuous(set = "comet"))

ggsave("ggUp.pdf",plot=ggUp,height=8,width=8)

motifsDo <- peakAnnoEnrichment(
    seMarker = markerTest,
    ArchRProj = proj,
    peakAnnotation = "Motif",
    cutOff = "FDR <= 0.1 & Log2FC <= -0.5"
  )
    df <- data.frame(TF = rownames(motifsDo), mlog10Padj = assay(motifsDo)[,1])
    df <- df[order(df$mlog10Padj, decreasing = TRUE),]
    df$rank <- seq_len(nrow(df))

ggDo <- ggplot(df, aes(rank, mlog10Padj, color = mlog10Padj)) + 
  geom_point(size = 1) +
  ggrepel::geom_label_repel(
        data = df[rev(seq_len(30)), ], aes(x = rank, y = mlog10Padj, label = TF), 
        size = 1.5,
        nudge_x = 2,
        color = "black"
  ) + theme_ArchR() + 
  ylab("-log10(FDR) Motif Enrichment") +
  xlab("Rank Sorted TFs Enriched") +
  scale_color_gradientn(colors = paletteContinuous(set = "comet"))


ggsave("ggDo.pdf",plot=ggDo,height=8,width=8)

plotPDF(ggUp, ggDo, name = "Markers-Motifs-Enriched", width = 5, height = 5, ArchRProj = proj3, addDOC = FALSE)


enrichMotifs <- peakAnnoEnrichment(
    seMarker = markersPeaks,
    ArchRProj = proj3,
    peakAnnotation = "Motif",
    cutOff = "FDR <= 0.1 & Log2FC >= 0.5"
  )
heatmapEM <- plotEnrichHeatmap(enrichMotifs, n = 7, transpose = TRUE)
plotPDF(heatmapEM, name = "Motifs-Enriched-Marker-Heatmap.pdf", width = 8, height = 6, ArchRProj = proj3, addDOC = FALSE)


proj3 <- addTrajectory(
    ArchRProj = proj3,  name = "track", groupBy = "celltype",
    trajectory = c("OPC","Malignant"), 
    embedding = "UMAP", force = TRUE
)
trajMM  <- getTrajectory(ArchRProj = proj3, name = "track", useMatrix = "MotifMatrix", log2Norm = FALSE)
trajGSM <- getTrajectory(ArchRProj = proj3, name = "track", useMatrix = "GeneScoreMatrix", log2Norm = TRUE)
trajGIM <- getTrajectory(ArchRProj = proj3, name = "track", useMatrix = "GeneIntegrationMatrix", log2Norm = FALSE)
trajPM  <- getTrajectory(ArchRProj = proj3, name = "track", useMatrix = "PeakMatrix", log2Norm = TRUE)

corGSM_MM <- correlateTrajectories(trajGSM, trajMM)
trajGSM2 <- trajGSM[corGSM_MM[[1]]$name1, ]
trajMM2 <- trajMM[corGSM_MM[[1]]$name2, ]
trajCombined <- trajGSM2
assay(trajCombined,withDimnames=FALSE) <- t(apply(assay(trajGSM2), 1, scale)) + t(apply(assay(trajMM2), 1, scale))
combinedMat <- plotTrajectoryHeatmap(trajCombined, returnMat = TRUE, varCutOff = 0)
rowOrder <- match(rownames(combinedMat), rownames(trajGSM2))
ht1 <- plotTrajectoryHeatmap(trajGSM2,  pal = paletteContinuous(set = "horizonExtra"),  varCutOff = 0, rowOrder = rowOrder)
ht2 <- plotTrajectoryHeatmap(trajMM2, pal = paletteContinuous(set = "solarExtra"), varCutOff = 0, rowOrder = rowOrder)

pdf("plotTrajectoryHeatmap1.pdf",width=12,height=6)


corGIM_MM <- correlateTrajectories(trajGIM, trajMM)
trajGIM2 <- trajGIM[corGIM_MM[[1]]$name1, ]
trajMM2 <- trajMM[corGIM_MM[[1]]$name2, ]
trajCombined <- trajGIM2
assay(trajCombined,,withDimnames=FALSE) <- t(apply(assay(trajGIM2), 1, scale)) + t(apply(assay(trajMM2), 1, scale))
combinedMat <- plotTrajectoryHeatmap(trajCombined, returnMat = TRUE, varCutOff = 0)
rowOrder <- match(rownames(combinedMat), rownames(trajGIM2))
ht3 <- plotTrajectoryHeatmap(trajGIM2,  pal = paletteContinuous(set = "blueYellow"),  varCutOff = 0, rowOrder = rowOrder)
ht4 <- plotTrajectoryHeatmap(trajMM2, pal = paletteContinuous(set = "solarExtra"), varCutOff = 0, rowOrder = rowOrder)
pdf("plotTrajectoryHeatmap2.pdf",width=12,height=6)
ht3+ht4
dev.off()
